text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Each year it handles more than 2,500 items of business that the departments and the Federal Chancellery present to the Federal Council.", "gist": "The section processes over 2,500 business items annually from departments and the Federal Chancellery for the Federal Council."}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "It plans the Federal Council meetings, draws up the agenda, runs the joint reports procedure and issues the decisions made by the Federal Council.", "gist": "The section is responsible for planning meetings, preparing agendas, managing joint reports, and publishing Federal Council decisions."}]}
